title: Complex And Adaptive System Behavior
stance: Studies emergence, nonlinear behavior, load sharing, adaptation, and system-level behavior under stress.
centralClaim: Some failures and behaviors only appear at the system level, after interactions compound beyond local components.
whyItMatters: This family gives the map a nonlinear systems layer and prevents the packet from being only process and architecture.

contributors.name: Complex systems and load-sharing research
contributors.reason: Complex systems and load-sharing research represents the source evidence for Complex And Adaptive System Behavior.

objections: Can be too abstract for direct design decisions.
Emergent behavior is hard to verify before deployment.
Complexity explanations can become unfalsifiable if not tied to evidence.
